newsitem.title: UK: UK Takeover Panel not to force TREG retraction.
newsitem.headline: UK Takeover Panel not to force TREG retraction.

text.p: Britains Takover Panel is not looking to force the chairman of the TR European Growth Trust Plc to retract criticisms of the board of bid target Kleinwort European Privatisation Investment Trust Plc.
"We are not demanding a retraction," said a spokesman for the panel, which enforces fair play in takeover bids.
On Friday, TR European described the board of Kleinwort European as using "smoke and mirrors to implement a cozy city fix," statements which press reports say the KEPIT board objects to.

The takoever panel spokesman declined to comment directly on the issues affecting TR Europeans bid for the 500 million stg KEPIT trust but said that in general the panel would warn off protagonists before issuing any demands for retraction.
"I do not see any useful purpose in commenting directly on TR European and KEPIT, but in general we would seek to have a word with advisors before they crossed the threshold," said the spokesman.
